independent_mathematical_review.verdict: Accepted as a scoped prospective mathematical design under its explicit assumptions; no blocking mathematical defect found after the conditioning clarification.
analytic_review: The iid complete-block law supplies unbiased full sample covariance for linear contrasts; asymptotic studentization additionally requires positive population contrast variance and does not supply a finite block-count gate.
The terminal-payoff frozen known-propensity score is valid under its declared marginal/conditional laws and has the sufficient K=2 bound [-6,7]. It is not ordinary refitted cross-fitting.
Four-vector coefficients for fresh, offline and calibration differences retain all cross-coordinate covariance. Multiplicity and prespecified equivalence tolerance remain separate requirements.
N times the sampled branch mean has conditional expectation equal to the latent total under uniform prefix sampling and the conditional continuation-mean restriction, including an empty frame.
The six-total ratio gradient and signs are correct. Pooling totals targets ratios of expected totals; averaging frame ratios generally does not.

Hoeffding coordinate error allocation, parameter-range intersections, positive-denominator corner inversion and full-range fallbacks give the stated conservative coverage under the full observation law.
Nothing repairs the one-block archive, completion-time retention, cross-block dependence or unverified restoration law.
independent_mathematical_review.clarification_requested: At the calibration identity ET=EU1-EU0, state that restored d_bi agrees with the source target-continuation mean at the corresponding eligible prefix/history (or a precise common conditioning set). The conditional branch mean restriction alone does not imply this equality.
